answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in jetty, expire in hollow, and relic lists each expiry. An attacker running 172 aliases thus needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1783 identities would post 910 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
